{{External|rs|dw=Abyssal Whip}} {{Infobox Item |name = Abyssal whip |image = [[File:Abyssal whip.png]] |release = [[15 February]] [[2005]] |update = Ghosts Ahoy and Slayer Update |members = Yes |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wield, Drop |examine = A weapon from the Abyss. |value = 120001 |weight = 0.453 |exchange = Yes |id = 4151 |leagueRegion = General,Kourend,Misthalin,Morytania,Wilderness }} [[File:Abyssal whip detail.png|130px|left]] The '''abyssal whip''' is a one-handed [[melee weapon]] which requires an [[Attack]] level of 70 to wield. It can be obtained as a drop from [[abyssal demon]]s or from sacrificing an [[unsired]]. The whip is among the most powerful and popular non-degradable melee weapons and is capable of attacking at the same speed of [[daggers]] and [[scimitars]] at 2.4 seconds per hit. As it performs great against monsters that are weak to [[Attack types|slash]] attacks and is relatively affordable, it is one of the most widely used melee weapons in the game and is a popular choice used to train the [[Slayer]] skill at higher combat levels before more powerful weapons become accessible. While still less powerful than other weapons such as the [[Ghrazi rapier]] and [[blade of Saeldor]], the whip is still very popular among players for its simplicity and cost. It is a good training weapon for those wishing to increase their [[Attack]] or [[Defence]], but not [[Strength]], as the "Lash" option only provides shared experience between all three styles. Though it falls off compared to other weapons when they are obtained, holding a whip is recommended for the purpose of Master [[Treasure Trails]], in which two potential steps require a whip. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = +82 |acrush = 0 |amagic = 0 |arange = 0 |dstab = 0 |dslash = 0 |dcrush = 0 |dmagic = 0 |drange = 0 |str = +82 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = weapon |speed = 4 |attackrange = 1 |combatstyle = Whip |image = [[File:Abyssal whip equipped male.png|150px]] |altimage = [[File:Abyssal whip equipped female.png|150px]] }} {{CombatStyles|Whip|speed=4|attackrange=1}} ==Special attack== [[File:Energy Drain.gif|frame|A player performing the abyssal whip's special attack, ''Energy drain''.]] The abyssal whip has a [[special attack]], ''Energy Drain'', which consumes 50% of the player's special attack energy, increases accuracy by 25%, and in [[Player killing|PvP]], transfers 10% of the target's run energy to the wielder. The target player will receive the message, "You feel drained!" in their chat window. The accuracy roll for ''Energy Drain'' is made against an opponent's slash defence.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/904101556034920449|date=2 September 2017|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/103702|archivedate=24 December 2022|quote=[Are whip & dscim spec tooltips correct? Supposedly more accurate, but my experience has been exactly the opposite. (...)] Both have a 25% accuracy buff, rolling against your opponent's effective slash defence.}} ==Upgrading== Players can attach a [[kraken tentacle]] to the abyssal whip to create an [[abyssal tentacle]], which requires an [[Attack]] level of 75 and has +8 higher [[slash]] attack and +4 higher [[Strength#Strength bonus|Strength bonus]], equating to about 1 higher damage. This process, however, will cause the whip to be consumed, and cannot be undone. Once the abyssal tentacle consumes all of its 10,000 charges, the player will retain the kraken tentacle. {{Infotable Bonuses|Abyssal whip|Abyssal tentacle|nototals=yes}} Furthermore, using a [[Shattered relics variety ornament kit]] on an abyssal whip will change its appearance into that of an [[abyssal whip (or)]]. Players can also use either a [[volcanic whip mix|volcanic]] or [[frozen whip mix]], obtained from [[Justine's stuff for the Last Shopper Standing]] to cosmetically enhance the abyssal whip, creating a [[volcanic abyssal whip]] or a [[frozen abyssal whip]], respectively. This only alters its appearance, and causes the whip to become untradeable. It can be reverted by using a [[cleaning cloth]] on the whip, but the mix will not be returned. ==Products== {{Uses material list|Abyssal whip}} ==Treasure Trails== {{EmoteClue}} *{{SherlockChallenge|Equipping an abyssal whip in front of the [[abyssal demon]]s in the [[Slayer Tower]]|master}} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Abyssal whip}} ==Sound effects== {{SFXTableHead}} {{SFXLine|file=Equip whip.wav|desc=Wielding}} {{SFXLine|file=Whip attack.wav|desc=Attacking}} {{SFXLine|file=Abyssal whip special attack.wav|desc=Special attack}} {{SFXTableBottom}} ==Used in recommended equipment== {{Used in recommended equipment|Abyssal whip}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 23 March 2022 |update = Guardians of the Rift Launch |change = The item's examine text was changed; previously, it was "A weapon from the abyss." }} {{Subject changes |date = 10 April 2014 |update = Easter & Slayer Updates |poll = Old School - Update priorities & new slayer drops |change = The Abyssal whip can now be combined with the [[kraken tentacle]] to create the [[abyssal tentacle]]. }} {{Subject changes |date = 29 August 2006 |update = Demons, Dragons and Giants |change = The item's value was increased again from 100,001 to 120,001. }} {{Subject changes |date = 16 May 2006 |update = Game engine upgraded! |change = The item's animation was reverted. }} {{Subject changes |date = 20 February 2006 |update = Updates, updates and more updates... |change = The item's value was increased from 100,000 to 100,001. }} {{Subject changes |date = 16 January 2006 |update = Agility Pyramid |change = The item's animation was updated. }} {{Subject changes |date = 22 June 2005 |update = Rogues Den + Tweaks |change = The item's special attack was updated. The '''berserker ring''' is the [[strength bonus]] variant of the [[Fremennik rings]] and is dropped by [[Dagannoth Rex]] in the [[Waterbirth Island Dungeon]]. The Fremennik rings are some of the very few rings to give stat bonuses. [[Group Ironmen]] who do not have individual prestige  require at least 1 Dagannoth Rex kill before they are able to wear this item.

It can be imbued into a [[berserker ring (i)]], doubling its bonuses, by using 650,000 [[Nightmare Zone]] reward points or 325,000 with the [[Combat_Achievements/Hard|hard tier]] of [[Combat Achievements]], 260 [[Soul Wars]] [[Zeal Tokens]], or a [[scroll of imbuing]] purchased for 200 [[Emir's Arena]] reward points.

The berserker ring is one of a handful of rings that provide a [[strength bonus]]. Thus, it is commonly used in melee setups because strength bonus raises the player's [[maximum hit]], which is usually more beneficial than accuracy for lowering kill times.

The ring makes the biggest difference when facing monsters with low Defence, but in general even against higher defence targets it will provide better DPS than rings which only provide accuracy bonuses. In specific situations where long-term DPS is not a concern (for example special attacks or boss mechanics), if crush accuracy is needed the [[Tyrannical ring]] should be used; for slash accuracy a [[Warrior ring|warrior]] or [[bellator ring]] should be used.

Players can use a [[chisel]] on the berserker ring to create a [[berserker icon]] after completing [[Desert Treasure II]]. This process requires 80 [[Crafting]] (boostable), and is part of the process for creating the [[ultor ring]].

The '''black mask''' is a unique mask worn in the head slot. The mask has the same stats as a [[black med helm]]. It provides a player 16.67%{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/689105142382198784|date=18 January 2016|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/108599|archivedate=26 May 2020|quote=7/6.}} [[Attack]] and [[Strength]] boost against all monsters on the player's current [[Slayer task]]. It requires 20 Strength, 10 [[Defence]], and 40 [[Combat]] to equip.

The black mask is a rare drop from [[cave horror]]s. Killing them requires 58 [[Slayer]] and completion of the [[Cabin Fever]] quest to access the island they live on, [[Mos Le'Harmless]].

When charged, the mask has a passive ability to lower an attacking monster's Defence by 2 + 7% rounded down, using one charge in the process. In order for the mask to activate the following requirement must be met:
* NPC must attack the player
* NPC must be within 10 tiles
* NPC must have 50% health or more.
* NPC must not have reduced defence already.

There is a 1/10 chance to attempt triggering the effect.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1615381970497806340|date=17 January 2023|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/98720|archivedate=20 March 2023}} If it succeeds, then it rolls your magic accuracy vs the NPC's magic defence.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1270264880180985857|date=09 Jun 2020|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/104003|archivedate=28 Aug 2020|quote=If it does perform its attack, it'll use a charge. To perform it:- NPC must be within 10 tiles - NPC must have 50% health or more. - NPC must not have reduced defence already. Then it rolls your magic accuracy vs the NPC's magic defence.}} Once the mask has been drained of all 10 charges, there is no way to recharge it; however, the Attack and Strength boosts remain.

For 1,250,000 [[Nightmare Zone]] points or 625,000 with the [[Combat_Achievements/Hard|hard tier]] of [[Combat Achievements]], 500 [[Soul Wars]] [[Zeal Tokens]], or a [[scroll of imbuing]] purchased for 200 [[Emir's Arena|PvP Arena]] [[PvP Arena Rewards|points]], players can imbue a black mask, making it into a [[black mask (i)]], which provides a 15% [[Ranged]] and [[Magic]] accuracy and damage boost in addition to its melee boost. Imbuing a charged black mask gives an imbued version with the same number of charges, though the imbued version loses charges similarly to the unimbued mask.

Players with 55 [[Crafting]] (boostable) and who have unlocked the ''Malevolent Masquerade'' ability from any [[Slayer Master]] for 400 [[Slayer reward point|Slayer reward points]] can combine a black mask with other items of Slayer headgear to make a [[slayer helmet]]. Note that this causes the mask to lose all of its charges.

Players with 53 [[Construction]] can use a black mask to upgrade their player-owned house's [[combat dummy]] into an [[undead combat dummy]] and improve their hit when using the [[ancient mace]] special attack to boost prayer points.
